answer: Duplicating identities requires re-staking full collateral plus recomputing unique work per vertex, so attack cost scales linearly with fake participants while honest peers attest cheaply. Each agent must stake tokens tied to a unique verified vertex in the reputation slot graph, and to register it must submit a fresh sonnet-style proof-of-work challenge whose solution seeds a sparrow signature checked against that vertex. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
